recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31778; future producedFrom example or ingredient-contrast edits should be handled under their own Jira issues.
issue_request: FHIR-31778 was a Published FHIR-core BRR change request for R5, resolved Persuasive. It asked how the then-named subject element differed from producedFrom and requested clearer documentation; the accepted Jira comment supplied revised formOf and producedFrom wording.
initial_application: Commit 1b2115f889ff949f5ecf21d904239e5e3988dbc6 renamed AdministrableProductDefinition.subject to formOf under FHIR-31776. Commit fbfbf287b1ed7a1add0a216ec02cd2d6daab062c added initial longer formOf/producedFrom documentation and mentioned FHIR-31778. Commit 3ead23f980f2842cae3556ba0d92db7042893116 applied the revised FHIR-31778 formOf/producedFrom text that matches the Jira comment.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes AdministrableProductDefinition, so the StructureDefinition is in current build scope. Later Applied issue FHIR-41432 added a compatible one-to-one producedFrom clarification that explains the extra current producedFrom sentence. FHIR-31785, a separate producedFrom-versus-ingredient issue, is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current StructureDefinition already states that formOf references the overall product and producedFrom identifies the specific manufactured items from that product used in this administrable form, preserving the accepted FHIR-31778 distinction and later accepted FHIR-41432 refinement.

related_jiras.note: Renamed AdministrableProductDefinition.subject to formOf, explaining the old element name in the FHIR-31778 summary.
Separately audits producedFrom versus ingredient wording and is already represented on the combined branch.
